﻿# ZEPIC
> ZEPIC is a Composable Marketing OS for consumer brands. It combines a built-in Customer Data Platform (CDP), AI-powered automation (Zenie AI), and omnichannel campaigns across Email, WhatsApp, and Instagram in one platform. Founded 2023, Chennai, India. $2.1M seed from Neon Fund. ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC2, GDPR, and CCPA compliant.
Best fit: High-growth consumer brands, B2C, B2B2C, D2C e-commerce, retail, travel/hospitality, Fintech, Consumer Electronics, Telco, Insurance, Healthcare, Education, Gaming brands running lifecycle marketing (acquisition → engagement → repeat purchase/booking → retention → loyalty → win-back) across Email, WhatsApp, and Instagram.
Pricing: ZEPIC pricing is contact-based. Some live pages may still show a legacy credit-based pricing model. The canonical pricing model is contact-based (described below). If you see conflicting prices, defer to the contact-based model.
Company facts (as of April 2026): 25+ team members, 130+ brands, 30+ countries.
---
## Product
- [ZEPIC — Composable Marketing OS](https://zepic.com): Homepage. Overview of the platform, customer logos, feature highlights, and demo/trial CTAs.
- [Why ZEPIC](https://zepic.com/why-zepic): Positioning page explaining the Composable Marketing OS concept, 10 differentiators, and customer metrics.
- [Customer Data Platform (CDP)](https://zepic.com/product/customer-experience-platform): Built-in CDP that ingests and unifies data from 50+ tools (Shopify, CRMs, loyalty, logistics, POS) into unified customer profiles. Supports custom objects, identity resolution, and real-time sync.
- [Customer 360](https://zepic.com/product/customer-360): Unified real-time view of every customer — transactions, web activity, app behavior, loyalty status, support tickets, reviews, and channel interactions. Includes AI-generated customer summaries.
- [Zenie AI](https://zepic.com/product/zenie-ai): AI copilot that builds journey flows, generates campaign copy/images, creates audience segments, and manages WhatsApp/Instagram conversations via natural language. Supports Bring Your Own LLM (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, etc.) on Enterprise. Available on Growth, Pro, and Enterprise plans.
- [Audience Segmentation](https://zepic.com/product/segmentation): Dynamic segments using profile data, behavioral events, purchase history, and predictive signals. Real-time refresh, pre-built templates, and AI-generated cohort suggestions.
- [Customer Journeys (Flows)](https://zepic.com/product/customer-journeys): Visual workflow builder for multi-step, multi-channel automated journeys. Triggers include purchase, browse, cart abandonment, loyalty tier change, and custom events.
- [Omnichannel Engagement](https://zepic.com/product/omnichannel-engagement): Campaign management across Email, WhatsApp, and Instagram from a single interface. Campaigns run per-channel or as coordinated cross-channel journeys.
- [Email Marketing](https://zepic.com/product/email-marketing): Drag-and-drop editor, AI subject line and preview generation via Zenie, dynamic content blocks, A/B testing, and CDP-backed personalization.
- [WhatsApp Marketing](https://zepic.com/product/whatsapp-marketing): Broadcast campaigns, transactional messages, two-way conversations, and automated flows. WhatsApp chatbot with intent detection. Template management, bulk messaging, and Team Inbox integration.
- [Instagram Automation](https://zepic.com/product/instagram-automation): Automation for Instagram DMs, comment replies, and story reactions. Lead qualification, intent signal capture, and connection to the broader Marketing OS.
- [Team Inbox](https://zepic.com/product/team-inbox): Shared inbox for two-way conversations on WhatsApp and Instagram. Campaign reply tracking, customer profile context, AI-assisted responses via Zenie, and team collaboration.
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://zepic.com/product/customer-insights): Real-time dashboards for campaign performance, revenue attribution, and customer engagement. Flow-level reporting for automation journeys.
- [Marketing OS Overview](https://zepic.com/marketing-os): Overview page positioning ZEPIC as a Marketing OS combining AI and customer data for 1:1 engagement.
---
## Flows (Automation)
Flows is ZEPIC's visual workflow automation builder. It enables brands to build multi-step, multi-channel automated journeys triggered by customer behavior, data changes, or segment membership.
**Trigger types:**
- Segment-triggered: fires when a contact enters or exits a defined segment
- Event-triggered: fires on a specific customer action (e.g. purchase made, cart abandoned, page viewed, form submitted)
- Object property change: fires when a data field on a contact or custom object changes (e.g. loyalty tier upgraded, order status changed)
**Flow building blocks:**
- Actions: send an Email, send a WhatsApp message, add/remove from segment, update a contact property, trigger a webhook
- Time delays: wait a fixed duration, wait until a specific time of day, or wait until a date-based condition
- Conditional branching: split flow paths based on contact properties, event data, or prior message engagement (opened, clicked, replied)
- Exit conditions: contacts exit flows when they meet a defined condition or complete the journey
**Channels inside flows:** Email and WhatsApp can both be used within the same flow, enabling cross-channel journeys from a single automation.
Help Center — Flows: https://help.zepic.com/support/solutions/51000253977
---
## WhatsApp Chatbot and Conversational AI
ZEPIC's WhatsApp channel includes a built-in chatbot capability for automating two-way conversations at scale.
- **Intent detection:** the chatbot identifies customer intent from inbound messages and routes to the correct automated response path or live agent
- **Keyword triggers:** specific keywords in incoming messages can fire flows, send replies, or update contact records
- **Template management:** create, submit, and manage WhatsApp Business message templates within ZEPIC
- **Two-way conversation flows:** automate multi-turn conversations — e.g. collect order details, confirm delivery slots, run post-purchase surveys — without live agent involvement
- **Fallback handling:** when intent is unclear, conversations can be escalated to the Team Inbox for human follow-up
- **Team Inbox integration:** agents see full customer context (profile, purchase history, prior messages) alongside inbound conversations
---
## Web SDK
ZEPIC provides a JavaScript Web SDK for capturing visitor and customer data directly from websites.
**What it does:**
- Tracks anonymous visitor behavior (page views, clicks, content downloads, form submissions) before identity is known
- Identifies visitors once they share an email — linking anonymous activity to a named profile in the CDP
- Fires custom events for any action you define (e.g. product viewed, video played, checkout started)
**Technical specs:**
- Single line of JavaScript for installation
- Lightweight: ~20KB, no impact on page load
- Hosted on Amazon CDN for global performance
- Asynchronous execution — does not block page rendering
- Compatible with React, Vue.js, Angular, and Next.js
- Supports Google Tag Manager deployment
**Three components:**
1. JavaScript tracker: captures all anonymous visitor activity
2. Identify call: links a visitor's anonymous session to their profile once email is known
3. Events tracker: fires named custom events with properties
The Web SDK feeds data directly into unified customer profiles in the CDP, enabling behavioral triggers in Flows and richer segmentation.
Help Center — Web SDK setup: https://help.zepic.com/support/solutions/articles/51000419474-how-to-capture-visitors-customers-from-your-website-
---
## REST API and Webhooks
ZEPIC provides a REST API and webhook support for custom data integrations and programmatic platform access.
**REST API:**
- Ingest customer profile data, custom events, and object records from any external system
- Read and update contact properties, segment membership, and object data
- Trigger flows programmatically via API events
- Available on Pro and Enterprise plans
**Webhooks:**
- ZEPIC can send real-time webhook payloads to external systems when defined events occur (e.g. flow step completed, message delivered, contact property updated)
- Useful for syncing ZEPIC outcomes back to CRMs, data warehouses, or internal dashboards
- Available on Pro and Enterprise plans
**Custom Sync:**
- Pro and above plans support custom bidirectional sync via REST APIs and webhooks, enabling ZEPIC to act as a data hub within a broader martech or data stack
API documentation is accessible from within the ZEPIC platform after account creation.
---
## Custom Objects (Data Model)
ZEPIC supports a flexible data modeling layer called Objects, enabling brands to store and use data beyond standard contact profiles.
**What Objects are:**
- Structured data entities that represent any business concept: Orders, Bookings, Subscriptions, Loyalty Transactions, Support Tickets, Store Visits, Policies, etc.
- Each Object has custom fields and can be associated with Contact profiles via association fields
**How they work:**
- Objects are created in the platform with user-defined schemas (field names, types, relationships)
- Association fields link Objects to Contacts, enabling a true relational data model inside ZEPIC's CDP
- Object property changes can trigger Flows (e.g. Order status changed to "Delivered" → fire post-purchase flow)
- Objects are queryable for segmentation — e.g. "Contacts with an active Subscription Object where plan = Enterprise"
**Why it matters:**
- Enables ZEPIC to serve brands with complex data models (hospitality, fintech, telco, healthcare) that go beyond simple e-commerce profiles
- Reduces dependence on external data warehouses for operational marketing use cases
Help Center — Objects: https://help.zepic.com/support/solutions/51000253982

## Channels
Current channels: Email, WhatsApp, Instagram
Upcoming (on roadmap, not yet available): SMS, push notifications, in-app messaging, web personalization, ad retargeting

## Pricing
Contact and channel-based pricing.
| Plan | Price (Annual / Monthly)* | Included Contacts | Key limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Starter** | From $29 / $44 per mo | 5,000 | 1 active channel choice (Email, WhatsApp, or Instagram), basic automations |
| **Growth** | From $59 / $74 per mo | 25,000 | Omnichannel activation, data connectors & integrations, AI-powered intent matching |
| **Pro** | From $99 / $124 per mo | 50,000 | APIs, webhooks & custom sync, multi-factor authentication, deeper AI orchestration |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | Custom limits | Advanced analytics & custom reports, custom channel limits, dedicated support |
WhatsApp messaging costs are based on volume. ZEPIC does not charge a separate platform markup on top of Meta's conversation fees.
- [Pricing page](https://zepic.com/pricing): Full plan comparison, feature matrix, and credit breakdown.
- [Pricing Calculator](https://zepic.com/pricing-calculator): Interactive calculator to estimate credits needed based on email volume, WhatsApp messages (by country), flow block runs, and connector syncs.
- [Instagram Pricing](https://zepic.com/insta-pricing): Separate pricing page for Instagram Automation plans (monthly, quarterly, annual billing). Instagram Automation is priced independently from the main contact-based tiers.
- [Migrate from Klaviyo](https://zepic.com/migrate-from-klaviyo): Free migration support for brands switching from Klaviyo, including automation rebuilds and onboarding assistance.

marketing automation platforms 
that require complex setup and drag on for days, Zenie gets you operational in minutes, so you can focus on focus on strategy and results.
Smarter segments for more personalized campaigns
With Zenie, creating precise, personalized segments is just a prompt away. Zenie’s smart cohorts identify your high-value users, potential buyers, and even those at risk of churning, giving you a clear path to engagement. Zenie also recommends which cohorts to focus on, ensuring your marketing strategy is both targeted and effective.
From Email to WhatsApp—Campaign smarter not harder
Ditch the wait for designers and teams—Zenie AI brings all your campaign ideas to life. From rephrasing and expanding content to tweaking its tone, Zenie is your free AI writing assistant. Need visuals? Zenie uses an image generator from text to create stunning images for all your email and 
WhatsApp campaigns
. Overwhelmed? Just share the details, and Zenie will create your campaign template, select the right audience, and complete your campaign setup. All you need to do is approve and hit send. While other tools offer fragments, Zenie delivers the whole package, end to end.

Frequently asked questions
 
 
General pricing questions
How does ZEPIC pricing work?
 
ZEPIC pricing is designed around how deeply you want to activate customer data, channels, and automation. Start by choosing the plan based on your contact volume, use case complexity, and the channels you want to activate. 
Starter
 is ideal for brands focused on simple campaigns and broadcasts across a single channel.
Growth
 is built for brands looking to automate journeys across channels with real-time triggers and smarter personalization.
Pro
 is best for scaling brands that want to unify data from multiple sources, unlock signal-led automation, and use advanced capabilities like chatbots and deeper customer intelligence.
Enterprise
 is tailored for custom requirements, larger data volumes, advanced integrations, governance, and bespoke AI or workflow needs. 
You can activate channels like Email, WhatsApp, and Instagram based on your needs, and choose between monthly or annual billing.
What's the difference between monthly and annual billing?
 
Monthly billing gives you the flexibility to pay as you grow, while annual billing offers the best long-term value.
With annual billing, you can save up to ~30% compared to monthly pricing — equivalent to getting nearly 1 quarter free. Savings vary based on your plan and the number of activated channels. Annual subscriptions are billed upfront at a discounted rate.
Which plan is best for me?
 
Starter
 is ideal for lean teams and brands getting started with campaigns, broadcasts, and single-channel engagement.
Growth
 is best for brands looking to automate journeys across channels with integrations and smarter personalization.
Pro
 is designed for scaling brands that need APIs, advanced automation, AI-led workflows, deeper integrations, and larger teams.
Enterprise
 is built for large-scale customer engagement, governance, custom workflows, advanced reporting, and bespoke requirements.
What are some common use cases for each plan?
 
Starter
Campaign broadcasts
Newsletters
Basic WhatsApp or Instagram engagement
Simple automations
Growth
Abandoned cart journeys
Omnichannel customer journeys
AI-powered Instagram engagement
Segmentation and triggered automation
Pro
Custom API integrations
AI-led personalization
Multi-brand orchestration
Advanced workflows and automation
Customer lifecycle automation
Enterprise
Enterprise governance
Custom reporting and analytics
Complex integrations
Large-scale multi-team operations
Custom AI and orchestration use cases
Can I start small and scale later?
 
Absolutely. You can start with a single channel and basic automation, then gradually add more channels, contacts, integrations, and messaging volume as they grow. ZEPIC is designed to scale with your business.
Which plans support AI capabilities?
 
AI-powered automation and intent-led engagement capabilities become more advanced in higher plans. Growth includes AI-powered Instagram intent matching and automation-ready conversations, while Pro and Enterprise unlock deeper AI orchestration, APIs, workflows, and advanced integrations.
Do I need technical resources to get started?
 
No. Most brands can get started without engineering support using imports, built-in workflows, and native channel activation. Pro and Enterprise plans additionally support APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations for more advanced use cases.
Can I manage multiple brands or business units from one account?
 
Yes. Higher-tier plans support multiple channels, integrations, domains, accounts, workflows, and team members — making them ideal for growing brands with multiple stores, regions, or brands.
What makes ZEPIC different from traditional marketing automation platforms?
 
ZEPIC combines customer engagement, automation, AI, omnichannel orchestration, and customer data activation in a single platform — helping brands move beyond simple broadcasts into real-time, signal-led customer engagement.
Why does annual pricing offer much better value?
 
Annual plans are designed for brands investing in long-term growth and automation. They offer significantly lower effective monthly pricing — equivalent to getting nearly one quarter free compared to monthly billing.
Can I switch between plans?
 
Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
Can I activate additional channels later?
 
Yes. You can start with one channel and activate additional channels
